---
name: Icon request
about: Request a new icon for the Flood Icons library
title: "Icon request: "
labels: icon-request
---

**Icon name**
What should the icon be called?

**Style**
Mono-line or full colour?

**Category**
Which existing category does it belong in (e.g. FM1D, FM2D, SWMM, TUFLOW, Hydro) — or is this a new category?

**Reference / sketch**
Link, screenshot, or description of what the icon should look like.

**Where it'll be used**
Which product/screen needs this icon?
